title: Follow-ups from PR #221 review (backend-trade-journal-followup-review)
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #221, tracked here so they aren't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: Extract a shared `_to_closed_trade_out(row, grade)` helper in backend/app/api/routers/portfolio.py -- get_closed_trades and record_follow_up_review each independently construct an identical 16-field ClosedTradeOut(...) from a ClosedTradeORM row + TradeGrade; this PR itself had to add the two new follow-up fields to both call sites, which a shared helper would have made a one-place change instead.

decisions.decision: The duplicated ClosedTradeOut(...) construction had grown from 16 fields (as described in the checklist, current at PR #221's time) to 18 fields by the time this task was worked -- backend-trade-grade-letter added trade_letter_grade and backend-trade-journal-entry-notes added entry_notes/strategy (net +2 after removing the original description's undercount) landed on main after PR #221 merged. Extracted _to_closed_trade_out(row: ClosedTradeORM, grade: TradeGrade) -> ClosedTradeOut covering the current full 18-field shape rather than trying to preserve some intermediate 16-field version, since the goal (one place to update when ClosedTradeOut gains/loses fields) applies equally regardless of the exact current field count.
decisions.rationale: Matching the checklist's literal '16-field' phrasing would have meant deliberately reproducing an already-stale snapshot; the helper's whole purpose (per the task description) is to make future field changes a one-place edit, so it needs to reflect ClosedTradeOut's actual current shape, not the shape at PR #221 review time.

comments.summary: Verified the extracted _to_closed_trade_out(row, grade) helper is byte-identical to both original inline ClosedTradeOut(...) constructions in get_closed_trades and record_follow_up_review -- field-by-field diff of the pre-refactor code against the helper shows the same 17 fields, same source variables (row.* / grade.*), same cast(ExitReasonOut, row.exit_reason), same trade_letter_grade(grade.trade_grade_pct) call, no field dropped, added, or given a different value/default between the two call sites.

Confirmed this is a pure internal refactor with no wire-format change: backend/openapi.json has no diff against main, no schema (app/api/schemas.py) or route signature changed, consistent with the PR description's claim that no OpenAPI regeneration was needed.

Backend test suite: 1109 passed, 99.95% coverage overall, app/api/routers/portfolio.py at 100% line/branch coverage. ruff check, ruff format, and mypy all clean. Non-refactor hunks in the diff (_grade_closed_trades, get_portfolio, get_risk) are pure ruff-format line-wrapping with no logic change.

Non-blocking: the decisions entry (and PR description) claim ClosedTradeOut has grown to '18 fields', but an AST count of the schema and a manual count of the helper's field list both come to 17 fields exactly. The helper itself is complete and correct -- covers the real, full field set -- so this is purely a documentation/decision-record inaccuracy, not a code bug. Tracked as a follow-up.

review.notes: No UI surface -- this PR only touches backend/app/api/routers/portfolio.py (an internal helper extraction) with no schema/route change, so the browser walkthrough and e2e-test steps don't apply; explicitly skipped rather than silently omitted. area is backend/db (not backend/signals or backend/portfolio) and skill is null, so verify-elder-signal doesn't apply. No new module/dependency/layer added, so architecture-review doesn't apply. Filed docs/tasks/backend-trade-journal-followup-review-followups-followups.json for the one non-blocking finding (field-count inaccuracy in the decision record).

pr_decision.notes: Re-ran backend/.venv pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing myself: 1109 passed, 99.95% overall coverage, app/api/routers/portfolio.py at 100% line/branch -- matches pr-reviewer's reported numbers exactly. Independently regex-extracted all ClosedTradeOut(...) constructions from origin/main's portfolio.py and the new _to_closed_trade_out helper's body: both original inline call sites are byte-identical to each other (17 fields each) and, after normalizing grade.X -> grades[row.id].X (the call sites pass grades[row.id] as the grade arg), field-by-field identical in name, order, and source expression to the helper -- no field dropped, added, retyped, or given a different value. Confirmed `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- backend/openapi.json` is empty (zero diff) and no route/schema signature changed. Also confirmed schemas.py's ClosedTradeOut has exactly 17 fields via direct read, matching the tracked follow-up's correction of the decision record's '18 fields' claim. Checked ruff/mypy: portfolio.py itself is ruff/format/mypy-clean; the 7 ruff findings in unrelated test files pre-exist on origin/main (verified via a throwaway worktree) and aren't introduced by this diff, so they don't affect this PR's mergeability. No human PR comments found on #227.
